research.topic: How to prepare for your first therapy session – the smart questions you should ask
verified: Therapeutic alliance is a significant predictor of psychotherapy outcomes, accounting for a notable portion of variance.

sources.title: The alliance in adult psychotherapy: A meta-analytic synthesis.
Therapeutic alliance as a mediator of change: A systematic review and evaluation of research.

research.hook: What are the 4️⃣ questions you MUST ask before stepping into your first therapy session?
research.tip: Write your top 3‑5 questions on a sticky note or phone note the night before and bring it to the session.
dropped: Psychotherapy reduces anxiety and depression symptoms by about 50% (meta‑analysis of 300+ RCTs). (unsupported)
Confidentiality in therapy is protected by laws such as HIPAA, GDPR and the Indian Mental Health Act (unsupported)
Therapists have different specialties and may use models like CBT, ACT or psychodynamic therapy. (unsupported)
First therapy sessions typically last 45–60 minutes for assessment and goal‑setting. (unsupported)
Clients who ask questions report 20–30% faster symptom reduction. (unsupported)

data.title: First Therapy Session? Ye 4 Smart Questions Zaroor Poocho!
data.title_en: First Therapy Session? Ask These 4 Smart Questions

scenes.text: College ke stress se nipatna hai? Kabhi socha pehli therapy mein kya poochna?
scenes.text_en: Dealing with college stress? Ever wondered what to ask in your first therapy?
scenes.text_hi: कभी सोचा पहली थेरेपी में क्या पूछना?

scenes.text: Therapy pe jaane se pehle sabko doubt hota hai.
scenes.text_hi: थेरेपी पे जाने से पहले सबको डाउट होता है।

scenes.text_en: And point #3 is most important, listen.

scenes.text: Research ke mutabik therapist ke saath achha rishta outcome badhata hai.
scenes.text_en: Research shows a good therapist relationship boosts outcomes.
scenes.text_hi: रिसर्च के मुताबिक थैरेपिस्ट के साथ अच्छा रिश्ता आउटकम बढ़ाता है।

scenes.text: Therapeutic alliance outcome ka ek bada predictor hai.
scenes.text_en: Therapeutic alliance is a major predictor of outcomes.
scenes.text_hi: थेरेप्यूटिक अलायंस आउटकम का एक बड़ा प्रेडिक्टर है।

scenes.text: Ab main aapko 4 smart questions bataunga.
scenes.text_en: Now I'll share four smart questions you should ask.
scenes.text_hi: अब मैं आपको 4 स्मार्ट क्वेश्चन बताऊँगा।

scenes.text: Therapist ka approach aur techniques kya hain?
scenes.text_en: What is the therapist's approach and techniques?
scenes.text_hi: थेरेपिस्ट का अप्रोच और टेक्निक्स क्या हैं?

scenes.text: Mere goals ke liye yeh therapy kitni suitable hai?
scenes.text_en: How suitable is this therapy for my goals?
scenes.text_hi: मेरे गोल्स के लिए ये थेरेपी कितनी सूटेबल है?

scenes.text: Session ke dauran confidentiality kaise maintain hoti hai?
scenes.text_en: How is confidentiality maintained during sessions?
scenes.text_hi: सेशन के दौरान कॉन्फिडेंशियलिटी कैसे मेंटेन होती है?

scenes.text: Agar progress slow lage toh kya karun?
scenes.text_en: What should I do if progress feels slow?
scenes.text_hi: अगर मुझे प्रोग्रेस स्लो लगे तो क्या करूँ?

scenes.text: Apni top 3‑5 questions sticky note pe likho, leke jao.
scenes.text_en: Write your top 3‑5 questions on a sticky note and bring it.
scenes.text_hi: अपनी टॉप 3‑5 क्वेश्चन स्टिकी नोट पे लिखो, लेके जाओ।

scenes.text: Pehli session se pehle yeh questions poochna confidence badhata hai.
scenes.text_en: Asking these before the first session boosts confidence.
scenes.text_hi: पहली सेशन से पहले ये क्वेश्चन पूछना कॉन्फिडेंस बढ़ाता है।

data.description: Learn the four essential questions to ask before your first therapy session and why a strong therapeutic alliance matters. Follow a simple note‑taking tip to walk in confident.

fixes: Add a line referencing Indian students or young professionals (e.g., “College ke stress se nipatna hai?”)
Ensure each beat changes every 2‑3 scenes by grouping related points
Trim any redundant filler words to keep pacing tight
Confirm the hook stays under 9 words (it already does)
